name: ridl
information_for_contributors: Keyword list source of truth: crates/ridl-syntax/src/keywords.rs (RIDL_KEYWORDS).
A .ridl file is a typl file plus the ridl interaction layer, so this grammar
includes the typl patterns by reference (source.typl#...) rather than copying
them — the typl half never drifts. What it adds is the nine ridl keywords
(interface service signal event command query fixed require ensure), the `@`
timing annotation of ridl §9, the duration literals of ridl §2.1, and the
inline fallible return `T | E` of family general form §6.1.
Update this grammar and keywords.rs together when the registry changes.

durations.comment: ridl §2.1 duration literals. Matched before the typl numbers so `10ms` never highlights as the integer `10` followed by a bare word.
durations.name: constant.numeric.duration.ridl

timing.comment: ridl §9 — the `@` timing annotation, in both its strict-periodic `@Xms` and its `@[min..max]` range form. General form §6.2 fixes one generic meaning for the bounds: min is a rate floor, max a staleness bound.

keywords-declaration.comment: ridl §14 — the abstract shape and its global published declaration.
keywords-declaration.name: storage.type.ridl

patterns.comment: The expression operators of a require/ensure clause (ridl §13). Matched before the fallible pipe so `||` is never read as two returns.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.logical.ridl

patterns.comment: General form §6.1 — the inline fallible return `T | E` (ridl §7, §10.1).
patterns.name: keyword.operator.fallible.ridl
